sentences.text: Sophie Turner -LRB- born 21 February 1996 -RRB- is an English actress .

Turner made her professional acting debut as Sansa Stark on the HBO fantasy television series Game of Thrones -LRB- 2011 -- present -RRB- , which brought her international recognition and critical praise .	Sansa Stark	Sansa Stark	HBO	HBO	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones
